Deployment tradeoffs, not a measured speed ranking. Neither backend wins every model and traffic pattern.","zh":"表1：部署取舍，而非实测速度排名。没有一种后端能在所有模型与流量分布下都胜出。"}},"sources":[1,3,7,8]},{"heading":{"en":"7. Turn a working demo into a service","zh":"七、从跑通Demo到上线服务"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"Increase one capacity dimension at a time: context length, simultaneous sequences, then request rate. Include weights, KV cache, and runtime workspace in the memory budget. Keep compiled artifacts keyed by model revision, compiler/SDK, hardware target, precision, and shape/parallelism settings. NxD artifact paths and the standalone plugin's VLLM_CACHE_ROOT are different interfaces; use the cache mechanism documented for the route you chose.","zh":"每次只扩大一个容量维度：上下文长度、并发序列，再到请求速率。内存预算要计入权重、KV缓存与运行时工作空间。编译产物应按模型revision、编译器/SDK、硬件目标、精度和形状/并行配置区分。NxD产物路径与独立插件的VLLM_CACHE_ROOT属于不同接口，应使用对应路线的缓存机制。"},{"en":"For production, package the verified environment, prewarm it, then put it behind the application's authenticated network entry point. Record readiness, errors, time to first token, inter-token latency, tail latency, throughput, and complete instance cost. Test restart and artifact reuse, not only the first answer. The loopback examples are a starting point for local validation; load balancers and remote clients need an intentional network configuration.","zh":"上线时，把验证过的环境打包并预热，再放到应用已有认证与网络入口之后。记录就绪状态、错误、首token延迟、token间延迟、尾延迟、吞吐和完整实例成本。除了第一条回答，还要测试重启及产物复用。本机绑定示例用于起步验证，负载均衡器和远程客户端需要明确配置网络路径。"},{"en":"The cost question becomes useful only after quality and service levels match. Compare cold start and warm operation separately, replay the same input/output-length distribution, and count retries and failed requests. Include migration and ongoing backend maintenance. A lower instance-hour price can still lose if useful throughput is lower or rollout effort is much higher.","zh":"只有质量和服务目标对齐之后，成本问题才有意义。把冷启动与热运行分开比较，回放相同的输入输出长度分布，并计入重试与失败请求。还应计算迁移与持续维护成本。实例每小时更便宜，如果有效吞吐更低，或上线工作量更大，也可能并不划算。"}],"sources":[1,2,3]},{"heading":{"en":"8. When it fails, follow the layers","zh":"八、遇到故障，按层排查"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"No devices: inspect host drivers and container device mappings. Plugin not detected or dependency conflicts: check the active environment and the version line, then rebuild a clean matched environment. Unsupported architecture: verify that the exact backend has a model implementation rather than assuming Hugging Face availability means Neuron support.","zh":"设备不可见：先查宿主机驱动和容器映射。插件未识别或依赖冲突：核对激活环境与发布线，再重建干净、匹配的环境。模型架构不支持：确认该后端已有对应实现，不要把Hugging Face上能下载等同于Neuron已支持。"},{"en":"Compilation slow or timing out: inspect progress, capacity, and timeout configuration before assuming a hang. Out of memory: reduce context or concurrent sequences before changing several flags together. API connection refused: confirm readiness, listening address, and port mapping. After any correction, repeat the short request before restoring realistic load.","zh":"编译慢或超时：先检查进度、资源与超时配置，不要直接断定卡死。内存不足：先降低上下文或并发序列，避免同时修改多个参数。接口连接被拒绝：检查就绪状态、监听地址与端口映射。每次修正后先重跑短请求，再恢复真实负载。"},{"en":"My preferred order is simple: one supported model, one verified environment, one correct response, then measured scale.
